title: 第八十九章玉灵苏醒第八十八章搅动东土大陆
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙至尊诀正文第八十九章，玉灵苏醒！（..la）神玉空间内。
秦风缓缓睁开眼睛，当他发现自己竟再一次进入了做梦都想来的地方时，掩饰不住脸上的喜悦道：“玉灵！！你醒了？？”
很快，一团能量飞动秦风身边道：“是的，主人。”
“我要是再不醒，你都要把自己给玩死了。”
看着眼前这团能量，秦风瞪大瞳孔道：“你....你就是玉灵？”
“没错，主人。”
“这些天我吸收了不少灵气，而且还将婺城里的灵气也吸收了许多。”
“也算是勉强能够苏醒。”
“加上那尊九龙至尊鼎所灌入你体内的龙气，这才让我提前醒来，且有了能量体。”
玉灵回应道。
“原来如此。”
“看来多亏了那尊鼎，要不是它，恐怕我都已经嗝屁了。”
“这玩意还真是厉害。”
“只可惜，我无法用它作战！！”
“诶！！”
秦风叹气道，若是能够用此神物御敌，就算是血刀狂人自己也不惧啊。
“可以了，主人。”
“你的战斗经验成长极快，如今只差修为罢了。”
“我能感受到你的成长。”
“但还是要尽快修炼九龙至尊诀才行。”

“黑龙诀的威力还并没有完全发挥出来。”
玉灵再次回应。
“好的，我会好好修炼九龙至尊诀的，可是，我总感觉修炼的时候，缺少了什么东西。”
“看似修炼到了尽头，但却无法冲破枷锁。”
“就好像，永远都修炼不到第二诀。”
“不久前，我和龙家一些长老交战的时候，就发现了这个问题，总是在关键时候，无法用尽全力。”
“莫非是哪里出现了问题？？”
秦风将自己的感受说了出来。
他早就发现了这个问题，但却无法与人沟通或者交谈，总不能去找吴熵问吧？人家铁定不知道啊。
更不可能去找龙战问了，要是现在二人见面，恐怕龙战得毫不犹豫的将自己给拿下。
“这个问题，在你修炼九龙至尊诀的时候，我就说了。”
“虽然你体内有龙气，但你缺少最为重要的东西，那就是龙的血脉。”
“也就是龙血！！”
“只要你能弄到龙血，无论什么品级的，都可以使你修炼的神法之威，变得更加强大。”
“包括修炼速度也一样。”
“如今之计，得看主人你什么时候能够弄到龙血了，否则，你永远都无法修炼到第二诀。”
“就算你的境界有所突破也不行。”
玉灵再次语气加重道，并且不断围着秦风转圈圈。
后者闻言，眉头紧蹙，大脑飞速转动，但想了半天，也没想到自己该去什么地方弄龙血。
要知道，那可是龙血啊！！不是什么凶兽所能相比的。

放眼整个东土大陆，有没有龙血都还是个问题呢。
“看来，只能去四方商会碰碰运气离开。”
“这一次，倒是欠了四方商会人情。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 89 of the main text of Kowloon Supreme Jue, the Jade Spirit Awakens! (..la) In the divine jade space.
Qin Feng slowly opened his eyes. When he found that he had once again entered the place he had dreamed of visiting, he could not hide the joy on his face and said: "Yuling!! Are you awake??"
Soon, a ball of energy flew around Qin Feng and said: "Yes, Master."
"If I don't wake up, you're going to kill yourself."
Looking at the energy in front of him, Qin Feng's pupils widened and he said, "You...are you the Yuling?"
"Yes, Master."
"I have absorbed a lot of spiritual energy these days, and I have also absorbed a lot of spiritual energy in Wucheng."
"It can be considered as barely able to wake up."
"Coupled with the dragon energy poured into your body by the Nine Dragons Supreme Cauldron, this allowed me to wake up early and have an energy body."
Yuling responded.
"That's it."
"It seems that it's all thanks to that cauldron. If it weren't for it, I might have burped."
"This thing is really powerful."
"It's a pity that I can't fight with it!!"
"Hey!!"
Qin Feng sighed and said, if this magical object can be used to defend against enemies, even the blood-sword madman himself will not be afraid.
"That's enough, Master."
"Your combat experience has grown extremely fast, and now you only need to improve your cultivation."
"I can feel you growing."
"But we still need to practice the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique as soon as possible."
"The power of the Black Dragon Art has not been fully exerted."
Yuling responded again.
"Okay, I will practice the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique well, but I always feel that something is missing when I practice."
"It seems that I have reached the end of my cultivation, but I can't break through the shackles."
"It's like you will never be able to practice the second technique."
"Not long ago, when I was fighting with some elders of the Long family, I discovered this problem. I was always unable to use my full strength at critical moments."
"Is there something wrong somewhere??"
Qin Feng expressed his feelings.
He had discovered this problem a long time ago, but he couldn't communicate or talk with others. He couldn't ask Wu Entropy, right? They definitely don’t know.
It is even more impossible to ask Long Zhan. If the two met now, Long Zhan would probably take him down without hesitation.
"I said this when you were practicing the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique."
"Although you have dragon energy in your body, you lack the most important thing, which is the dragon's bloodline."
"That's dragon blood!!"
"As long as you can get dragon blood, no matter what grade it is, you can make the power of the divine magic you practice more powerful."
"Including the speed of cultivation."
"The current plan depends on when, Master, you can obtain dragon blood. Otherwise, you will never be able to practice the second technique."
"It won't work even if your realm has a breakthrough."
Yu Ling said in a more serious tone again, and kept circling Qin Feng.
When the latter heard this, he frowned and his brain was spinning rapidly, but after thinking for a long time, he still couldn't think of where he should go to get dragon blood.
You know, that's dragon blood! ! It is not comparable to any ferocious beast.
Looking at the entire Eastern Earth Continent, whether there is dragon blood or not is still a question.
"It seems that we can only go to the Sifang Chamber of Commerce to try our luck and leave."
"This time, I owe the Sifang Chamber of Commerce a favor."
